description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces token's trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
